name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
description: A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.
readmeExcerpt:
English  ·  简体中文  ·  Guide  ·  ACP  ·  Extensions  ·  Spec  ·  Website  ·  Discord  ·  QQ


Open source · MIT · a single Go binary

A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.

One local engine, four ways in — terminal, desktop app, browser, or your editor over ACP. Plan mode, permissions, a workspace sandbox and per-turn checkpoints keep a long autonomous run something you can still read and undo.

Maintained by Huahui Yu.

> [!IMPORTANT] > **Community · 加入社区** — bilingual Discord for setup help (`#help` / `#求助`), workflow showcases, and feature ideas. → **** > > QQ group **DeepSeek-Reasonix官方群** (`1093562660`) → **** ([QR code](./docs/assets/qq-group.svg)) > Douyin: **做游戏的小鱼** (Douyin ID `22703872788`) · [QR code](./docs/assets/douyin.png)
## Versions Reasonix ships on two lines. See the [version roadmap announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/discussions/10748) for the reasoning behind the split. | Line | Branch | Status | Get it | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | [Studio releases](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) | | **Reasonix 1.x** | [`main-v2`](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/main-v2) | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · [desktop download](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) | - **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended. - **Want the new architecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome. Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported or reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture. - [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md): what the two lines share, and how to run both on one machine without losing sessions. - [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md): what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships, and the decisions still open. ## Features - **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in `reasonix.toml`. No hardcoded models. - **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions. - **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages. - **Cache-aware context maintenance.** Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review. - **Zero-friction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself. ## Install This branch is **Reasonix 2.x**. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI, Studio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine. ### Reasonix Studio (2.x) Download the package for your platform from the latest [Studio release](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) (tagged `studio-v2.*`; candidates such as `-rc.N` are marked as pre-releases): | Platform | Package | Architecture | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | `.dmg` or `.zip` | Apple Silicon (`arm64`) / Intel (`amd64`) | | Windows | Installer `-installer.exe` or portable `.zip` | x64 | | Linux | `.deb` | x64 | Every package ships with a `.minisig` signature, and the release carries `SHA256SUMS`. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place. The same release also carries the 2.x `reasonix` CLI as archives for `darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64`. ### Reasonix 1.x (stable) The 1.x CLI installs through npm on any supported platform, or Homebrew on macOS: ```sh npm i -g reasonix # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix # macOS ``` The 1.x desktop app is on the [official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start). Windows installers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate. ### VS Code extension The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local `reasonix acp` backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first. - **VS Code:** [install from Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SivanLiu.reasonix-agent) - **VSCodium / Eclipse Theia:** [install from Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/SivanLiu/reasonix-agent) - **Extension ID:** `SivanLiu.reasonix-agent` · [source and usage guide](https://github.com/SivanCola/reasonix-vscode) ### Build from source Clone the repository; `studio` builds 2.x and `main-v2` builds 1.x: ```sh git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git cd DeepSeek-Reasonix git switch studio ``` #### CLI The CLI build requires **Go 1.25+**. The module pins a `toolchain` directive; keep `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it. ```sh make build # -> bin/reasonix(.exe) make cross # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64) ``` #### Studio Studio additionally requires **Node 24+ and pnpm 10** (`npm install -g pnpm@10`) for the frontend. ```sh make studio ``` See the [Studio build guide](desktop/README.md#prerequisites) for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags. ## Quick start ### Reasonix Studio Install and launch Studio, then connect a provider and model in the app. No CLI setup is needed. ### CLI / TUI ```sh reasonix setup # configure a provider and model reasonix # start an interactive session reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go" ``` In an interactive session, run `/init` when you want Reasonix to create project instructions. For advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the **[CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md)**, **[Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md)**, and **[configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md)**. ## Documentation - **Getting started:** [Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md) · [CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md) · [Configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md) · [ACP editor integration](./docs/ACP.md) - **Features & troubleshooting:** [Subagent profiles](./docs/SUBAGENT_PROFILES.md) · [Context Engine v2](./docs/SESSION_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL.md) · [Capability diagnostics](./docs/CAPABILITY_DIAGNOSTICS.md) · [Recovery and updates](./docs/RECOVERY.md) · [Checkpoints & rewind](./docs/CHECKPOINTS.md) - **Engineering & migration:** [Spec](./docs/SPEC.md) · [Task contracts & pause policy](./docs/TASK_CONTRACT.md) · [Tool contract](./docs/TOOL_CONTRACT.md) · [Moving from 1.x to 2.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md) · [2.x roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md) - **Extension development:** [Skills](./docs/SKILLS.md) · [Extensions](./docs/EXTENSIONS.md) · [Plugin packages and Manifest v1](./docs/PLUGIN_PACKAGES.md) · [Extension Protocol](./docs/EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md) · [Go SDK and starter](./sdk/go/README.md) ## Star History
readmeHtml:
English  ·  简体中文  ·  Guide  ·  ACP  ·  Extensions  ·  Spec  ·  Website  ·  Discord  ·  QQ


Open source · MIT · a single Go binary

A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.

One local engine, four ways in — terminal, desktop app, browser, or your editor over ACP. Plan mode, permissions, a workspace sandbox and per-turn checkpoints keep a long autonomous run something you can still read and undo.

Maintained by Huahui Yu.

Important

Community · 加入社区 — bilingual Discord for setup help (#help / #求助), workflow showcases, and feature ideas. → https://discord.gg/XF78rEME2D

QQ group DeepSeek-Reasonix官方群 (1093562660) → https://qm.qq.com/q/i59b0z2R8s (QR code)

Douyin: 做游戏的小鱼 (Douyin ID 22703872788) · QR code


Versions

Reasonix ships on two lines. See the version roadmap announcement for the reasoning behind the split.

Line Branch Status Get it
Reasonix 2.x studio (this branch) Active development Studio releases
Reasonix 1.x main-v2 Maintenance / stable npm i -g reasonix · desktop download
  • Want something stable? Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended.
  • Want the new architecture? Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome.

Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported or reimplemented on 2.x where they fit the new architecture.

  • Moving from 1.x to 2.x: what the two lines share, and how to run both on one machine without losing sessions.
  • 2.x roadmap: what 2.x still has to deliver, how it ships, and the decisions still open.

Features

  • Config-driven. Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in reasonix.toml. No hardcoded models.
  • Multi-model & composable. DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions.
  • Plugin-driven. MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages.
  • Cache-aware context maintenance. Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review.
  • Zero-friction distribution. CGO_ENABLED=0 single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself.

Install

This branch is Reasonix 2.x. Its desktop app is Reasonix Studio; the CLI, Studio, and editor integrations all run the same local Reasonix engine.

Reasonix Studio (2.x)

Download the package for your platform from the latest Studio release (tagged studio-v2.*; candidates such as -rc.N are marked as pre-releases):

Platform Package Architecture
macOS .dmg or .zip Apple Silicon (arm64) / Intel (amd64)
Windows Installer -installer.exe or portable .zip x64
Linux .deb x64

Every package ships with a .minisig signature, and the release carries SHA256SUMS. Once installed, Studio updates itself in place.

The same release also carries the 2.x reasonix CLI as archives for darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64.

Reasonix 1.x (stable)

The 1.x CLI installs through npm on any supported platform, or Homebrew on macOS:

npm i -g reasonix                  # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary
brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix   # macOS

The 1.x desktop app is on the official download page. Windows installers are code-signed with a Certum code-signing certificate.

VS Code extension

The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local reasonix acp backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. Install the 1.x CLI first.

  • VS Code: install from Visual Studio Marketplace
  • VSCodium / Eclipse Theia: install from Open VSX Registry
  • Extension ID: SivanLiu.reasonix-agent · source and usage guide

Build from source

Clone the repository; studio builds 2.x and main-v2 builds 1.x:

git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git
cd DeepSeek-Reasonix
git switch studio

CLI

The CLI build requires Go 1.25+. The module pins a toolchain directive; keep GOTOOLCHAIN=auto so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it.

make build      # -> bin/reasonix(.exe)
make cross      # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64)

Studio

Studio additionally requires Node 24+ and pnpm 10 (npm install -g pnpm@10) for the frontend.

make studio

See the Studio build guide for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags.

Quick start

Reasonix Studio

Install and launch Studio, then connect a provider and model in the app. No CLI setup is needed.

CLI / TUI

reasonix setup                      # configure a provider and model
reasonix                            # start an interactive session
reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go"

In an interactive session, run /init when you want Reasonix to create project instructions.

For advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the CLI reference, Guide, and configuration paths.

Documentation

  • Getting started: Guide · CLI reference · Configuration paths · ACP editor integration
  • Features & troubleshooting: Subagent profiles · Context Engine v2 · Capability diagnostics · Recovery and updates · Checkpoints & rewind
  • Engineering & migration: Spec · Task contracts & pause policy · Tool contract · Moving from 1.x to 2.x · 2.x roadmap
  • Extension development: Skills · Extensions · Plugin packages and Manifest v1 · Extension Protocol · Go SDK and starter

Star History


Acknowledgments

Built by the community at esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix

Support this project

If Reasonix has been useful and you'd like to say thanks, you can. It stays a coffee, not a contract — donations don't buy feature priority or change how issues get triaged.

releases.name: Reasonix Studio v2.31.0
releases.body:
本版首次提供原生 Windows ARM64 版 Studio，任务运行时可让电脑保持唤醒，反馈面板新增等级显示，并修复链接标签、压缩、队列重试、钩子放行等问题。

## 新增

- 首个原生 Windows ARM64 版：发布页提供 ARM64 安装程序和便携 zip，外壳与内核均为 ARM64，不再靠 x64 模拟；ARM64 机器按自己的平台更新，增量更新暂只对 x64 提供，会下载完整安装包 (#12272, #12286, #12270)
- 任务运行期间让电脑保持唤醒：设置的外观页「窗口」新增本机开关，默认开启，只阻止系统空闲睡眠，合上盖子由系统决定，后台作业不计入 (#12283)
- 我的反馈显示已获得的等级、已采纳数、距下一级的进度和当前限额；提交或回复被限流时说明哪个时间窗用完及何时重置，`/feedback list` 同样显示。仅作显示，目前不改变任何限额 (#12319)
- 已收到的反馈被维护者审阅时，反馈面板显示「审核中」 (#12260)
- 反馈对话框新增「铺满窗口」按钮，较长的维护者回复不再挤在窄列里 (#12111 by @xxoingr, #11575 fixed in #12111 by @xxoingr)
- 模型目录加入 MiMo V2.6（pro、flash、pro-ultraspeed），未改动过的 V2.5 预设自动迁到 V2.6；小米将于 2026-10-21 停用 V2.5 (#12262)
- 设置的子代理行会指出哪些 `subagent_models` 条目优先于它，并提供「改回跟随这里」按钮；项目级条目只提示 (#12306)

## 变更

- 不再主动推送上下文占用警告：对话里不再出现「上下文已达压缩阈值」卡片，模型仍可用 `context_budget` 工具按需查询 (#12248)
- 终端界面 `reasonix tui` 首次交互运行时询问一次是否允许匿名使用统计；在 1.x 里回答过的不再询问，`DO_NOT_TRACK`、CI 和开发版不询问也不上报 (#12336)
- Studio 的每日匿名心跳失败后会退避重试，开着跨过 UTC 午夜会再发一次；在设置里关闭遥测后无需重启即停止发送 (#12333)
- 拦截类事件上的钩子无法执行（匹配正则无效、进程启动失败、载荷无法序列化）时，现在阻止该操作，不再当作没有钩子而放行 (#12261)
- 增量更新要下载的内容超过完整包一半时，直接下载完整包，不再先拉分块再失败重来 (#12247)
- 会话在等待提问或审批回答期间释放工作区写入占用，其他会话可以写这期间没人在写的路径 (#12298)
- 读取服务商模型列表的入口挪到添加模型输入框旁，标签和提示更明确 (#12279)
- 状态栏的子代理数只统计正在运行的，与后台任务数

releases.name: Reasonix CLI v1.39.8
releases.body:
> 修复未声明读图能力的模型被图片卡住后续所有消息、回复被中断后会话无法打开、QQ 审批请求收不到、与 Studio 共用的项目里删除和归档会话反复失败，旧版恢复链一次归档，子代理工具调用出现在主对话里，以及 Command Code 的一个偶发错误。

**发布渠道：稳定版 · v1.39.8**

[English →](https://reasonix.io/changelog/v1.39.8/?lang=en) · [网页版完整更新日志 →](https://reasonix.io/changelog/v1.39.8/)

## 概览

**Reasonix v1.39.8 — Reasonix 1.39.8**

修复未声明读图能力的模型被图片卡住后续所有消息、回复被中断后会话无法打开、QQ 审批请求收不到、与 Studio 共用的项目里删除和归档会话反复失败，旧版恢复链一次归档，子代理工具调用出现在主对话里，以及 Command Code 的一个偶发错误。

发布日期：2026-10-07

**Desktop 8 · CLI 4**

## 桌面端更新

### 重点内容

- **[Desktop]** **目录反复重扫时，删除或归档会话不再一直失败** — 在部分项目里（同一个项目文件夹也被 Studio 2.x 打开过时出现），目录没有任何会话变化，却每隔几秒被重新扫描一次，随后任何删除或归档都会失败，提示「该会话正在执行相同操作」。现在锁文件、临时文件、附属文件和子目录的时间戳不再触发重扫，只有会话记录、元数据和事件日志的变化才会；同一目录的重扫会从 1 秒起逐步退避到 60 秒，真实的删除和改名不受退避影响；归档遇到忙碌的锁时最多等待 1.5 秒，不再立刻放弃。不会写入、移动或删除任何会话文件。 ([#11693](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11693), [#11722](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11722) by @esengine)
- **[Desktop]** **归档旧版恢复行时，整条恢复链一次归档** — 归档旧版恢复链里的某一行时，原来只会处理一到四个快照，每点一次都会留下新的副本，同一批要归档几十次。现在会顺着父节点找到整条恢复链，并一次归档。每个快照之间会释放锁，所以归档很长的链时，其他标签仍可正常使用。个别快照归档失败时其余照常归档，结果会报告还剩几个，再执行一次即可补完。源文件不会被删除或改写，已归档的副本仍可从「已归档」恢复。 ([#11581](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11581

releases.name: Reasonix Studio v2.30.0
releases.body:
本版重做服务商编辑表单、让模型的 render_chart 在对话里直接画成图表，并新增已完成未查看标记与技能 paths 门控；同时修复多会话并发卡顿、压缩触发偏晚和一批设置面板草稿丢失问题。

## 新增

- 服务商表单：编辑页有未保存提示、还原按钮和「已保存」回执，测试结果显示在对应按钮旁，新增「测试已启用模型」按钮与汇总行，底部固定保存栏支持 Ctrl/Cmd+S (#12189, #12193, #12196, #12202)
- 服务商表单：有未保存修改时切换服务或新增会产生询问，整体连接检查失败时会给出分类后的原因 (#12185, #12191)
- 模型调用 `render_chart` 后，对话里直接画出柱状图、折线图或饼图；终端界面显示为对齐的数据表 (#12179, #12181)
- 技能支持 `paths:` 声明：只有会话碰过匹配的文件后，该技能才会出现在模型的技能列表里 (#12192, #12195, #12199)
- 会话完成但还没看过时，侧栏和标签页会显示标记，重启后仍在，打开该会话才清除 (#12231, #12233, #12234)
- 手机网页端可以只读查看代理正在使用的浏览器标签页 (#12209)

## 变更

- 压缩触发改为参考服务商上次报告的提示词大小，带截图等本地估算偏低的会话不再拖到超窗口才压缩 (#12222)
- 压缩之后，模型自己写的任务清单、已全部完成的清单、折叠期间改过的文件和已通过的检查会重新随请求带上 (#12216)
- 附件被拒绝时，附件条直接显示原因（类型不支持、过大、为空、无法读取、写盘失败） (#12239)
- MCP 提示词获取失败时，提示会写明是哪个提示词、为什么失败，模型下一轮也会知道这次调用失败了 (#12241)
- 市场在注册表连不上时，显示上一次成功的浏览结果并标明是缓存 (#12210)
- 命令行：Ctrl+L 清屏，与 `/cls` 相同；补全菜单和 `/resume` 选择器支持 Ctrl+P/Ctrl+N 上下移动 (#12223 by @xxoingr, #12217 by @xxoingr)
- 添加服务商的探测被拒绝时保留错误代码，不再把对端回显的内容（可能含密钥）带进提示 (#12212 by @xxoingr)

## 修复

- 在后台启动的命令不再被画成红色失败；之后读取到后台任务失败或超时时，该调用会正确标为失败 (#12198, #12213 by @xxoingr)
- 同时开着多个会话时，被其他窗格遮住的窗格不再按流式输出速度重绘，界面明显更流畅 (#12237)
- 打开反馈对话框时背景不再做模糊，运行中的回合不再让 GPU 持续满载 (#12220)
- 连接远程机器时会接入已经在运行的服务，不再另起一个争抢会话租约，

aiSummary.oneLiner: An optimized reasoning engine designed to enhance the analytical capabilities of DeepSeek models.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: DeepSeek-Reasonix is a specialized framework that significantly boosts the complex problem-solving abilities of DeepSeek language models. It addresses the limitations of standard inference by implementing advanced prompting strategies and multi-step reasoning architectures directly into the execution pipeline. The technical approach involves breaking down intricate queries into smaller, verifiable sub-tasks and utilizing self-reflection loops to correct errors before generating the final output. What sets this apart is its specific tuning for the DeepSeek model family, extracting maximum performance for logic, math, and coding tasks without requiring massive computational overhead. It transforms a standard LLM into a highly deliberate reasoning engine.
keyFeatures: Multi-Step Decomposition: automatically breaks complex problems into manageable sub-tasks for more accurate processing.
Self-Correction Loops: implements built-in reflection mechanisms where the model critiques and refines its own intermediate answers.
DeepSeek Optimization: specifically tuned to leverage the unique architectural traits and training distribution of DeepSeek models.
Traceable Logic Paths: outputs the intermediate reasoning steps, providing transparency into how the final answer was derived.
Lightweight Integration: provides a clean API that can be easily dropped into existing inference pipelines without heavy dependencies.

useCases.title: Complex Mathematical Solving
useCases.description: Researchers use the engine to tackle advanced math problems where standard one-shot prompting frequently fails.

useCases.title: Algorithmic Code Generation
useCases.description: Software developers deploy it to generate highly optimized algorithms by forcing the model to plan the logic before writing syntax.

useCases.title: Legal Document Analysis
useCases.description: Analysts utilize the traceable reasoning paths to verify the logic used when extracting clauses from dense legal contracts.

useCases.title: Automated QA Verification
useCases.description: QA teams integrate the self-correction loops to build more reliable automated testing scripts that adapt to dynamic UI changes.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This framework is targeted at AI researchers, developers, and data scientists who require high-reliability outputs for complex logical tasks. It requires familiarity with LLM prompting techniques and basic Python integration.
